A_t = {
  CALL(tool,args),
  CALL_SET({tool,args}_i),
  ASK,
  WAIT,
  ABSTAIN,
  CONTINUE
}

M_a(z) =
Q_a(z) - max(
    Q_CONTINUE(z),
    max_{b != a, b admissible} Q_b(z)
)

rho_a(z) =
M_a(z) / || grad_h M_a(z) ||

S_a(tau) = {
  z : a is hard-admissible
      and M_a >= 0
      and rho_a >= tau
}
